summary: Iteration 4 e2e testing complete. Backend: new /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py (21 tests) covering GET /api/admin/servicenow/sync (schema + 403 end user + 401 anon), PUT (428 when enabled=true w/o SN creds; clamps hour_utc 30->23, lookback 999->365 & 0->1; binds sync_user_email to saving admin), POST /api/admin/servicenow/sync/run (ok:false 'ServiceNow credentials required' when bound to admin test user; ok:false 'ServiceNow not configured' in demo mode; 403 end user; audit action 'servicenow.sync' recorded), analyze() evidence payload (historical/kb/rca lists with id+score>0, kb has title, historical has number), stored on record (/api/analyses/mine), GET /api/evidence/{kb|historical|rca}/{id} 200 for end user with full body, 404 unknown kind ('Unknown evidence type'), 404 unknown id, 401 anon, and regression (/api/incidents admin 428, feedback analytics, post-to-servicenow 404 unknown). All 21/21 passed serially (test_iteration4 must run with -n 0 because TestEvidence.setup_class toggles instance_url and races xdist workers). Regression on prior suites (backend_test.py + test_new_features.py + test_iteration3.py) = 111/111 passed. Frontend (playwright): /admin/servicenow shows [data-testid=sync-panel] with all 7 subtestids visible; Save with toggle OFF succeeds silently (no error); Save with toggle ON as admin test user shows 'Save your ServiceNow credentials first' toast; 'Sync now' populates [data-testid=sync-last-result] with 'Failed … ServiceNow not configured / credentials required'. /admin/analyses shows 33 clickable rows; expanding a record with evidence renders [data-testid=linked-evidence] with '12 internal sources grounded this analysis' and clicking an evidence item opens [data-testid=evidence-dialog] with [data-testid=evidence-dialog-title] (e.g. 'pgbouncer connection pool exhaustion on auth-db'); older record shows [data-testid=linked-evidence-empty]. Same on /my-analysis as end user (16 rows). Demo-mode /incidents/sn_inc_0001: Analyze runs in ~5s, [data-testid=linked-evidence] renders ABOVE [data-testid=analysis-actions] (y=943 < y=1503), both evidence-group-kb and evidence-group-historical visible, clicking an item opens the dialog with Description / Root cause / Resolution sections. State FULLY RESTORED afterwards via mongosh: sn_sync {enabled:true, hour_utc:2, lookback_days:365, sync_user_id:user_33ad5ed974a9, sync_user_email:dhirajjaiswal17@gmail.com}, servicenow.instance_url=https://dev414250.service-now.com, ai.rate_limit_per_hour=10, historical count=33 (23 source:servicenow-sync + 10 seed).

minor.issue: Response merges cur (old) with payload and returns `sync_user_email` from payload; when 428 is raised the sync_user_id/email in the payload never touch the DB (correct), but the docstring 'PUT binds sync_user_id/email to the saving admin' is only true on the success path — worth clarifying in docs.

When there is no sync_user_id yet, the endpoint silently auto-binds the current admin (write to configs) BEFORE calling _run_resolved_sync — surprising for a 'run only' endpoint and it happens even in demo mode. Consider requiring an explicit PUT first.

Uses `now.hour == hour_utc` with a 60s sleep loop and de-dupes by comparing last_run[:10] to today's date — if a manual sync ran earlier the same day at hour_utc, the scheduled run for that day is skipped. Also uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup') to launch the task.

issues: `sync-last-result` renders 'Failed<newline>timestamp · trigger<newline>error' with no whitespace between the badge and the timestamp in DOM text (e.g. 'Failed2026-09-05 08:05 UTC · manualServiceNow not configured') — visually spaced but the raw text concatenation is jarring; add a separator or explicit spans/spaces.

action_items: Optional: don't auto-bind sync_user in run_sync — require an explicit PUT save first (currently a 'Sync now' from a fresh admin silently rebinds the sync account).
Optional: migrate @app.on_event('startup') → FastAPI lifespan and improve scheduler de-dup logic.
Optional: cosmetic spacing in sync-last-result text.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1155 lines — split into routers (auth, servicenow, sync, evidence, ai, imports, seed) per the >700-line guideline.
_build_context() still loads entire historical/kb/rca collections (to_list(20000)) on every analyze — will not scale; move to a Mongo text index / $search or precomputed embeddings.
Evidence scoring in _build_context and the payload construction in analyze() duplicate the same shape 3x (per collection) — could be extracted to a helper.

_sync_scheduler tick is 60 s and uses wall-clock hour equality — a container restart at, say, HH:01 during the target hour would still catch the run only if minute polling coincides; safer to use asyncio.sleep_until next hour and check inside the window.
seed_data_creation: None permanent. Created 1 fresh demo-mode analysis for user@test.local during Playwright evidence flow (harmless, appears on /my-analysis). All config state restored via mongosh at the end.
